title: Bill settled text + font flash fixed for good
summary: Garbled Open Gateway / Bill synced text came from Unicode symbols misread as Latin-1. Font swap after ~1s was PDF warm injecting global CSS over the live receipt. Export styles are now scoped; banners use plain ASCII only.
highlights: Bill synced / Open Gateway use plain ASCII (no mojibake)
PDF export CSS scoped so live preview fonts never jump
Receipt body uses stable system-ui + Georgia from first paint
Hard refresh once so service worker picks up v180
